title: Improving instruction hierarchy in frontier LLMs
summary: IH-Challenge trains models to prioritize trusted instructions, improving instruction hierarchy, safety steerability, and resistance to prompt injection attacks.
body: IH-Challenge trains models to prioritize trusted instructions, improving instruction hierarchy, safety steerability, and resistance to prompt injection attacks.
summaryZh: OpenAI通过IH-Challenge训练模型以强化指令层级（Instruction Hierarchy），旨在提升模型对核心指令的遵循能力、安全可控性以及对提示词注入攻击的防御水平。

aiReview.reasonZh: 探讨了前沿模型在指令遵循与安全性方面的优化方向，对模型对齐研究有参考意义。
